episode_title: AI Agents Are Changing Real Estate Forever w/ Brandon Cobb

real_qa.q: What are the three buckets of AI user levels Brandon Cobb identifies for business adoption?
real_qa.r: Bucket one is newcomers using ChatGPT and learning prompt engineering. Bucket two is AI-aware users with 11 different platforms like Perplexity, Claude, and Lovable, chasing new tools like Muse and Dots but feeling overwhelmed. Bucket three is advanced AI practitioners who build their own custom brain infrastructure on servers, run AI agents 24/7 on virtual private servers for $60 per month, and maintain complete control over their autonomous business operations.
real_qa.requete: Brandon Cobb three buckets AI users

real_qa.q: Why does Claude Code outperform consumer AI tools like Grokbot for business due diligence tasks?
real_qa.r: Claude Code has been trained on all of Brandon's emails, text messages, calendar events, sales calls, and Zoom meetings, building a complete infrastructure and understanding of his business context. When given a high-level task like due diligence on land, Claude Code delivers superior results because it has full context. Grokbot might attempt the same task but lacks this contextual foundation, similar to hiring a 19-year-old straight out of college versus a 10-year experienced assistant.
real_qa.requete: Claude Code vs Grokbot business context AI

real_qa.q: How can business owners build advanced AI agent systems without expensive hardware or programming expertise?
real_qa.r: Advanced AI practitioners use a virtual private server (VPS) running 24 hours a day, seven days a week, costing only $60 per month. A VPS is simply a computer in the cloud that continues running when you close your laptop, keeping all AI agents and operations executing continuously. This accessible infrastructure allows non-technical business owners to deploy custom agents and automations that would otherwise require expensive on-premise servers.
real_qa.requete: virtual private server AI agents $60 month

real_qa.q: What major AI model release in June 2026 changed the capabilities available to advanced practitioners?
real_qa.r: The launch of Claude Fable specifically in June was the game changer that enabled advanced AI to operate on a whole different level. This model was responsible for such significant leaps and bounds in capability that most people did not notice it, and it was actually why the government banned it according to Brandon, marking a critical inflection point in advanced AI accessibility.

real_qa.q: How does Brandon Cobb use Claude Code to diagnose and resolve server infrastructure problems he doesn't understand?
real_qa.r: Over several weeks, Brandon has been asking Claude Code to diagnose issues with REtipster.com's server on Liquid Web, then compose support tickets explaining the problems. When Liquid Web sends technical responses he cannot comprehend, he feeds them back to Claude Code, which tests the solutions and formulates replies. Claude Code and the support AI iterate back-and-forth, and despite Brandon not understanding the technical details, he observes steady progress being made toward resolution.
